item.title: DCI maps out its 55th anniversary 2027 tour to Indianapolis
item.description:
The road to Indianapolis has officially been mapped out. Drum Corps International has released the highlights of its 2027 tour schedule, running from late June through mid-August, as the organization heads into its 55th anniversary season.

The full schedule will take corps across the country over the summer, culminating in the championship weekend in Indianapolis. For fans, the release is the starting gun for planning — which shows to attend, which corps to follow, and how the summer builds toward finals. More details on individual dates and stops are in the full announcement.

item.title: Corps news roundup: Northern Lights announces 2027 show, Bluecoats head to Thailand
item.description:
This week's DCI corps news roundup leads with Northern Lights announcing its 2027 production, and the Bluecoats sending a performance group to Thailand. The Boston Crusaders, Spartans, and 7th Regiment are teaming up for a brass clinic, and the roundup also covers DCI All-Age and SoundSport updates.

It's the offseason, so the news is about planning rather than performance — but for drum corps fans, the 2027 season starts taking shape in announcements like these. Show reveals and international tours are the first signals of what next summer will look like.
